top_signals.title: Lloyds and Barclays shares fall as Healey ‘poised’ to hike bank tax
top_signals.summary: Shares in Britain’s banking giants tumbled this morning after new reports suggested John Healey is set to raise taxes on lenders when he delivers his first Budget at the end of the month. Natwest dropped two per cent to 660.40p, while Lloyds was down around 2.5 per cent to 103.40p. Barclays slid 0.4 per cent [...]
